# pai projects

Same as project

```
pai projects <command>
```

Same as `pai project`: Your registered projects: list, add, rename, check.

Shortcut for `pai project`.

```sh
pai projects list
pai projects info my-app
```

### pai projects list

Show your projects and sessions in one list

```
pai projects list [options]
```

Show your projects and sessions in one list.

Show the unified deduped listing (same as `pai`).
Use --all to include cold / zero-session / archived projects.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--all` | flag | — | Show all entries including cold / zero-session / archived projects |
| `--workers` | flag | — | With --all: also show headless worker sessions |
| `-n, --n COUNT` | string | — | Max rows to show |

```sh
pai project list
pai project list --all
pai project list --all --workers
```

See also: `pai project list-raw`

### pai projects list-raw

Plain table of every registered project

```
pai projects list-raw [options]
```

Plain table of every registered project.

Raw registry listing with slug, path, status, last_active columns

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--all` | flag | — | Include archived projects (default: active only) |
| `--status STATUS` | string | — | Filter by status: active | archived |
| `--tag TAG` | string | — | Filter by tag |
| `--type TYPE` | string | — | Filter by type |

```sh
pai project list-raw
pai project list-raw --status active --type project
```

See also: `pai project cd`, `pai project list`

### pai projects cd

Print how to change into a project's folder

```
pai projects cd IDENTIFIER
```

Print how to change into a project's folder.

cd to a project directory. Short form: pai cd <name>
(The shell wrapper handles the actual cd; pure output here.)
Auto-detects moved projects when the registered path no longer exists.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `IDENTIFIER` | yes | Project name, short name, number or part of its path |

```sh
pai project cd my-app
pai project cd 2
```

See also: `pai project add`, `pai project list-raw`

### pai projects add

Register a folder as a project

```
pai projects add PATH [options]
```

Register a folder as a project.

Register a project directory in the PAI registry

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `PATH` | yes | Folder path |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--slug SLUG` | string | — | Override auto-generated slug |
| `--type TYPE` | string | — | Project type: local | central | obsidian-linked | external |
| `--display-name NAME` | string | — | Human-readable display name |
| `--no-trust` | flag | — | Do not mark the folder trusted in Claude Code (~/.claude.json) |

```sh
pai project add ~/code/my-app
pai project add ~/code/my-app --slug my-app --display-name "My App"
```

See also: `pai project info`, `pai project cd`

### pai projects merge

Fold a duplicate project into another (preview unless --execute)

```
pai projects merge FROM INTO [options]
```

Fold a duplicate project into another (preview unless --execute).

Fold a duplicate project into another: move its sessions (renumbered), repoint its tags, aliases, compaction records and links, keep the old slug as an alias, then delete the row. Preview unless --execute is given.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `FROM` | yes | Project to fold away |
| `INTO` | yes | Project to keep |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--execute` | flag | — | Actually perform the merge |

```sh
pai project merge old-app my-app
pai project merge old-app my-app --execute
```

See also: `pai project unregister`, `pai project archive`

### pai projects unregister

Remove a project that should never have been registered

```
pai projects unregister SLUG [options]
```

Remove a project that should never have been registered.

Remove a project row entirely, for paths that should never have been registered (worktrees, temp dirs). Refuses when the row holds sessions — merge those first. Preview unless --execute is given. The directory itself is never touched.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `SLUG` | yes | Project name (see: pai project list) |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--execute` | flag | — | Actually remove the row |
| `--force` | flag | — | Remove even though sessions would be deleted with it |

```sh
pai project unregister stray-dir
pai project unregister stray-dir --execute
```

See also: `pai project unarchive`, `pai project merge`

### pai projects rebind

Point a project at a new folder after you moved it

```
pai projects rebind SLUG NEW_PATH
```

Point a project at a new folder after you moved it.

Manually update the root_path for a project (for when auto-detect found multiple matches).
Validates the new path exists and is a directory, then updates the registry.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `SLUG` | yes | Project name (see: pai project list) |
| `NEW_PATH` | yes | The new folder path |

```sh
pai project rebind my-app ~/code/new/my-app
pai project health
```

See also: `pai project here`, `pai project move`

### pai projects here

Declare the current folder to be this project

```
pai projects here NAME [options]
```

Declare the current folder to be this project.

Declare that the CURRENT directory is this project — no slug, no path.
Repoints an existing project of that name, or creates it. Stores the
canonical (realpath) location, so a symlinked parent cannot register the
same directory twice.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `NAME` | yes | Project name |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | flag | — | Show what would change without writing |

```sh
pai project here my-app
pai project here my-app --dry-run
```

See also: `pai project tag`, `pai project rebind`

### pai projects init

Set up this git project for PAI workers

```

```

Set up this git project for PAI workers.

Set up this git project for PAI workers: .pai/project.yaml (sink from the origin) and a starter .pai/worker.md, then run the project checks

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--anchor N` | string | — | Forge anchor issue number (sink forge) |
| `--marker TEXT` | string | — | Marker text that must occur in the anchor body |
| `--force` | flag | — | Overwrite existing files (old copies kept as .bak) |
| `--dry-run` | flag | — | Print what would be written; write nothing |

```sh

```

### pai projects consolidate

```

```

Gather scattered notes folders into the project's own Notes.


### pai projects config

Show or change how sessions of a project start

```
pai projects config [IDENTIFIER] [MORE...] [options]
```

Show or change how sessions of a project start.

View or modify session launch config for a project.
Use --options to discover available keys and presets.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `IDENTIFIER` | no | Project name, short name, number or part of its path |
| `MORE...` | no | More values for the list option above |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--set KEY=VALUE` | string | — | Set config values (repeatable) (several values allowed) |
| `--unset KEY` | string | — | Remove config keys (repeatable, use env.KEY for env vars) (several values allowed) |
| `--preset NAME` | string | — | Apply a permission preset: full | trusted | default |
| `--defaults` | flag | — | Manage global session defaults instead of a project |
| `--options` | flag | — | List available config keys and presets |
| `--json` | flag | — | Output JSON |
| `--reset` | flag | — | Reset config to empty (inherit global defaults) |

```sh
pai project config my-app
pai project config my-app --options
```

See also: `pai project mcp`, `pai project names`

### pai projects mcp

Show or set the MCP servers a project's session loads

```
pai projects mcp [NAMES...] [options]
```

Show or set the MCP servers a project's session loads.

View or set the MCP servers this project's interactive supervisor session
loads (run from inside the project, like `pai projects here`).
No args: print the current value. --set <names> (comma-separated): set it,
validated against ~/.claude.json's mcpServers. --clear: unset (all
servers load — today's default). Positional names are an error.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `NAMES...` | no | Comma-separated names (leave out to just show the current ones) |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--set NAMES` | string | — | Set the pin (comma-separated server or set names) |
| `--clear` | flag | — | Unset — all MCP servers load again |

```sh
pai project mcp
pai project mcp --set pai
```

See also: `pai project pins`, `pai project config`

### pai projects tools

Show or set the built-in tools a project's session loads

```
pai projects tools [NAMES...] [options]
```

Show or set the built-in tools a project's session loads.

View or set the built-in tool schemas this project's interactive
supervisor session loads (run from inside the project, like `pai projects
here`). No args: print the current value. --set <names> (comma-separated):
set it. --clear: unset (all tools load — today's default). Positional
names are an error.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `NAMES...` | no | Comma-separated names (leave out to just show the current ones) |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--set NAMES` | string | — | Set the pin (comma-separated tool names) |
| `--clear` | flag | — | Unset — all built-in tools load again |

```sh
pai project tools
pai project tools --set Read,Bash
```

See also: `pai project pins`

## Examples

```bash
# Jump into a project directory (with the shell wrapper installed)
pai cd pai

# Register the current directory as a project
pai projects add .

# Show everything known about a project
pai projects info pai

# Repair a project whose folder moved on disk
pai projects rebind pai /new/path/to/pai

# Audit all registered projects for dead / moved paths
pai projects health --fix
```
